description:
Base blueprint for Energy Community deployments (EnergyCommunity v2,
stream-data storage for metering values — see ADR 0001, AB#4549).

Installs the foundation every Energy Community v2 tenant needs:
- Energy Community runtime configuration entity (neutral defaults; fill via Refinery Studio).
  Includes the billing report / notification config the Billing pipelines read
  config-driven (billingReportName, billingReportFilePrefix,
  billingMailServerConfiguration, notificationEmailContact) — AB#4554 de-SBEG-ing.
- Auto-increment counters for customer numbers and billing document numbers
- Excel import pipeline (master data import via OctoMesh Office Add-In)
- Shared queries used by EDA and Billing pipelines, plus Excel-import queries
- Stream-data archives for Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement:
  - energy-measurements (raw TimeRangeArchive, 15-min windows) with the cascaded
    rollup ladder raw -> hourly -> daily -> {weekly, monthly} -> yearly
    (calendar-aligned, Europe/Vienna; SUM amountvalue_sum + MAX dataquality_max)
  - energy-measurements-legacy-daily (TimeRangeArchive, 1-day windows) with its
    own monthly + yearly rollup sub-ladder — migration tenants only, carries
    over pre-cutover daily EnergyQuantity history (ADR 0001 decision 3)
- Persisted stream-data queries over the raw archive (SimpleSdQuery + two
  GroupingAggregationSdQuery: by ObisCode and by DataQuality)
- Energy-statistics MeshBoard (System.UI/Dashboard
  `energy-community-energy-quantities` + widgets, AB#4578) bound to the SD
  queries above — Verbrauch/Erzeugung/Überschuss KPIs plus the formula KPI
  Erzeugung in EEG, by-OBIS pie, by-data-quality
  donut, 15-min time-series line chart. Requires the service-managed
  System.UI CK model (octo-platform-services running).
- manual-metering-entry pipeline (AB#4558): a deployed HTTP endpoint
  (POST /manualMeteringEntry) that upserts manual/corrected 15-min windows into
  the raw energy-measurements archive (ec0000000000000000000a01) for an existing
  EnergyMeasurement anchor, tagged dataQuality = Manual (Basic.Energy DataQuality
  key 4). CrateDB upsert on (window_start, window_end, rtId, ckTypeId) means a
  re-written window corrects it; retroactive writes auto-schedule rollup recompute.
  2.1.4 (AB#4558 fix): the pipeline now resolves the anchor EnergyMeasurement
  (GetRtEntitiesById@1) and carries its ObisCode into every write — ObisCode is a
  required non-null archive column, so omitting it made every write fail with a
  CrateDB XX000 "obiscode must not be null" 500. An orphan anchorRtId now returns
  status=error (HTTP 200) instead of a 500.
- aggregated-energy-report pipeline (AB#4710, 2.2.0): a deployed HTTP endpoint
  (POST /aggregatedEnergyReport) that returns the aggregated measured energy per
  metering point x OBIS anchor over a caller-supplied time range as JSON, with
  hard completeness, quality (no L3 intervals; Manual is a corrected value
  and OK) and overlap gates.
  2.4.1 reads the measurements through the stream-data nodes instead of the
  persisted SD query, and in that order: ONE GetStreamData@1 with gapsOnly
  for the whole request, then — only if it reports no gap at all — ONE
  AggregateStreamData@1 (SUM + COUNT of Amount.Value grouped by rtId +
  DataQuality, with Amount.Unit pinned to kWh by a field filter rather than
  grouped). Both are scoped by the resolved anchor rtIds and re-attached per
  anchor with Join@1. Measurements are never read over an incomplete range,
  so one gap anywhere means every entry comes back without figures. That
  replaces the per-anchor GetQueryById@1 against ec0000000000000000000a24
  (the query stays in the seed for external consumers) and turns the interval
  arithmetic into a real coverage report that names where the hole is.
  REQUIRES Mesh Adapter
  >= r3.4.119 (GetStreamData@1 r3.4.85, AggregateStreamData@1 r3.4.89,
  ExecuteCSharp@1 typed array arguments r3.4.119) — an
  adapter version is not expressible as a blueprint dependency, since
  System.Communication-[3.26,5.0) pins the CK model, not the adapter; an older
  adapter fails the pipeline with an unknown node type.

- allocate-community-energy pipeline (AB#5635, 2.10.0): the D+1 allocation of the
  community energy per 15-min slot (DataFlow ec0000000000000000000a51, pipeline …a52,
  cron trigger …a53 at 05:30 UTC). Reads the raw channels 1-1:1.9.0 G.01 / 1-1:2.9.0 G.01
  of metering points with MeteringDataSource Simulated or SelfReported, allocates the
  production dynamically (proportional to consumption, capped by PartitionFactor) and
  upserts the EDA register set into the raw archive: consumers 1-1:2.9.0 G.03, producers
  1-1:2.9.0 G.01T and 1-1:2.9.0 P.01T, each slot carrying the worst input data quality.
  Metering points with MeteringDataSource Eda are never written (the day aborts). The
  cut-off time of day comes from EnergyCommunity/CommunitySettings.AllocationCutOffTime
  (empty or no entity = 06:00 Europe/Vienna). Seeded Enabled=false; manual window via
  ExecutePipeline { startDay, numDays <= 31 }.
  REQUIRES Mesh Adapter with AllocateCommunityEnergy@1 (AB#5634) - an older adapter fails
  the pipeline with an unknown node type; the adapter version is not expressible as a
  blueprint dependency.
- meter reporting routes (AB#5636/5637/5639, 2.11.0): three deployed HTTP endpoints for
  metering points that report their own values (MeteringDataSource SelfReported), role
  MeterReporter: POST /registerMeteringPoint (DataFlow ec0000000000000000000a61, pipeline …a62)
  registers customer, facility, metering point, raw anchor and participation idempotently;
  POST /meterReadings (…a63/…a64) upserts validated 15-min values into the raw archive with
  DataQuality L1 until the day's cut-off; POST /communityBalance (…a65/…a66, also
  EnergyCommunityReporting) returns the provisional balance of the last closed slots without
  writing anything.

All archives are seeded Disabled (Archive.Status = 2). Activation is NOT part
of the blueprint install — run install-tenant.ps1 (ActivateArchive phase,
bottom-up) or activate manually via octo-cli -c ActivateArchive. Legacy
archives are only activated on migration tenants (-IncludeLegacyArchives).

2.4.3 (AB#3717): the Basic / Basic.Energy / EnergyCommunity floors move together to the
set EnergyCommunity 4.3.0 resolves (Basic 2.0.3, Basic.Energy 1.4.0). They are one set, not
three independent pins - see the note on ckModelDependencies. Existing tenants are unaffected:
a higher installed version already satisfies the old floors, and the new ones are what the
catalog offers anyway. 2.4.3 and not 2.4.2: these floors were written for 2.4.0 while this
branch was open, and 2.4.0 through 2.4.2 were published from main in the meantime carrying
the OLD floors. A published version is never overwritten, so a tenant installing 2.4.2 from
the catalog gets EnergyCommunity 4.2 and fails the registration seed dependency check.

2.4.5: the energy-statistics MeshBoard takes over the layout edited in Studio on eegroider -
four 1x1 KPIs (Verbrauch G.03, Erzeugung G.01T, Überschuss P.01T and the formula KPI
Erzeugung in EEG = creation - surplus), the by-OBIS pie filtered to those three series and
the data-quality donut filtered to G.03. The two new widgets keep their eegroider rtIds so
that tenant adopts them. 2.4.5 and not 2.4.4: 2.4.4 is already in the catalog.

Prerequisites:
- System.Communication blueprint installed on the tenant (provides default
  Pool 670…001, Mesh Adapter 670…002 and the meshmakers-apps Helm repo
  670…005 the app's HelmRepository association pins — seeded by BOTH
  variants since Release-1.5.0 / MainLatest-1.5.0 with the
  environment-correct URL (dev channel on dev/test, /apps on
  staging/production), AB#4706. On dev/test clusters the controller must
  carry MainLatest >= 1.5.0 or the app association targets a missing
  entity.
- Stream data enabled on the tenant (octo-cli -c EnableStreamData; CrateDB
  reachable) before activating the archives.

Post-install:
- Fill EnergyCommunityConfiguration values in Refinery Studio
- Activate the archives (see above)
- octo-cli -c DeployDataFlow --identifier <excelDataFlowRtId>

2.4.0 splits the seed across one file per topic (AB#4758 `seedDataPaths`) —
identical entities, no data change. It therefore requires an engine that knows
`seedDataPaths`: an older engine drops the unknown property, finds no
`seedDataPath` and installs an EMPTY seed while still reporting success.
Install 2.3.1 on such tenants.

2.4.5 -> 2.5.0: the raw archive ec0000000000000000000a01 opts in to conflict
resolution. Every archive write is an upsert on (window_start, window_end,
rtid, ckTypeId) and the update used to be unconditional, so the LAST delivery
won regardless of which document was newer — a re-sent or out-of-order
DATEN_CRMSG silently replaced a correction, and the stored value reflected
arrival order rather than source order. Measured on a real replay of this
archive: 16 of 565 consumer days kept a superseded value. The archive now
carries a SourceDocumentDate column (the source document's own timestamp, not
the ingest time) and names it as Archive.ConflictVersionColumn, so an incoming
point only replaces a stored one when it is at least as new. NOTE: that
single-column attribute was superseded by the ordered Archive.ConflictPrecedence
before either reached a published CK model — see 2.5.0 -> 2.6.0 below. 2.5.0 was
never published; a tenant that never saw it goes straight from 2.4.5 to 2.6.0.

2.5.0 -> 2.6.0: the raw archive's conflict resolution becomes TWO-KEY. Ordering by the
source document date alone was wrong for metering data, and a full replay proved it: 22
of 805 days came out different from the legacy values because a later L3 ESTIMATE
overwrote an earlier L1 MEASUREMENT. Since billing sums L1+L2 only, such a day then
bills as zero — 80.885 kWh over 3,375 windows on billed registers on the tenant this was
measured on.

ConflictPrecedence now declares [{DataQuality, LowerWins}, {SourceDocumentDate,
HigherWins}]: quality dominates, the document date breaks the tie. The keys are compared
lexicographically, which is what makes the result independent of arrival order — a
conjunction ("better quality AND newer") would still let a newer estimate beat an older
measurement whenever the estimate arrived first.

Raises two floors, and BOTH are load-bearing rather than housekeeping:
System.StreamData-[1.13,2.0) declares Archive.ConflictPrecedence (on a lower floor —
including 1.11.0 and 1.12.0, which were published for the System 2.3.0 cascade without
it — the attribute does not exist and the opt-in is silently ignored: the archive keeps
last-write-wins while the seed says otherwise), and Basic.Energy-[1.7,2.0)
declares EnergyMeasurement.SourceDocumentDate (without it the archive column
cannot resolve its type and activation fails). EnergyCommunity moves to
[4.6,5.0), the version built against that Basic.Energy. Requires all three models
to be published to the catalog.

2.6.0 -> 2.7.0 (AB#5359): CK floors only - Basic 2.2, Basic.Energy 1.8 and EnergyCommunity
4.7, the versions rebuilt against System 2.4.0. No entity changed. A compiled model carries
exact dependency versions, so the 2.6.0 set (built against System 2.3.0) does not resolve on
a platform that ships System 2.4.0; this version is what moves a tenant to the new set.
Install it only on an environment whose platform release carries System 2.4.0 - on an older
platform the three models cannot be imported.

2.7.0 -> 2.8.0 (AB#5528): CK floors only - Basic 2.3, Basic.Energy 1.9 and EnergyCommunity 4.8,
the versions rebuilt against System 2.5.0. No entity changed. Same reason as 2.7.0: the 2.7.0
set (built against System 2.4.0) does not resolve on a platform that ships System 2.5.0.
Install it only on an environment whose platform release carries System 2.5.0.

2.8.0 -> 2.9.0 (AB#5627): route security, phase A. /import/tree and /manualMeteringEntry move
from FromHttpRequest@1, which always registered its route anonymously, to FromHttpRequest@2
with allowAnonymous: false and requiredRoles: [] - a valid access token of this tenant is
required, any role will do. The EC app, the voest-app and the Office add-in already send one.
@2 would run the pipeline as the verified caller; every data node that supports it carries
identity: ServiceAccount, so the pipelines see and write exactly what they did before. Seeds the
roles EnergyCommunityManagement and EnergyCommunityReporting and the group
EnergyCommunityOperators (seed-data/identity/roles-groups.yaml), which phase B will require
on the routes - assign them first (docs/runbooks/ec-route-security-roles.md). CK floors unchanged.

2.9.0 -> 2.9.1 (AB#5627): the routes answer with a result, not with their data context.
The adapter returns the final data context of a FromHttpRequest pipeline verbatim - request
headers (all but Authorization/Cookie), the caller's principal and roles, the request body and
every intermediate result. /manualMeteringEntry now answers { status, message } at the top
level, where the EC app reads them (under $.response it never saw status=error);
/import/tree answers {} (the Office add-in reads only the HTTP status). CK floors unchanged.

2.9.1 -> 2.10.0 (AB#5635): the allocate-community-energy pipeline (see above). CK floors:
EnergyCommunity 4.9 (MeteringDataSource on Consumer/Producer, CommunitySettings with
AllocationCutOffTime) and System.Bot 3.1 (CronExpression on the daily PipelineTrigger, same
range as EdaIntegration). EnergyCommunity 4.9.0 is a minor over 4.8.0 on the same Basic 2.4 /
Basic.Energy 1.9 set, so Basic and Basic.Energy floors stay. Billing, EdaIntegration and
Simulation install on top unchanged. A tenant that carries EnergyCommunity.Registration needs
Registration 2.7.0 (compiled against EnergyCommunity 4.9.0, AB#5653) imported right after this
upgrade: 2.6.0 pins 4.8.0 exactly and goes ResolveFailed (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, "Upgrading Base
when the tenant carries Registration").

2.10.0 -> 2.11.0 (AB#5636, AB#5637, AB#5639): meter reporting for self-reported metering
points (requirements MTR-01..05, BAL-01..03). Why: a member, a lab group or a storage
controller that measures its own meters had no way to bring those values into the community;
the D+1 allocation (2.10.0) already reads SelfReported metering points but nothing could
create or feed them. Three new DataFlows, each FromHttpRequest@2 with allowAnonymous: false,
deployed on the default Mesh Adapter (DeploymentState 2, Enabled):
- /registerMeteringPoint (…a61/…a62): idempotent registration of customer, operating facility,
  metering point (MeteringDataSource SelfReported), raw anchor and participation period. Only
  numbers in the reserved range AT009998… are accepted (NUMBER_RESERVED otherwise), so a client
  can never adopt an EDA or simulated metering point. Every facility gets a Basic/City
  parent by the optional request field zipcode (default 5020), which the app needs to show
  it; the tenant therefore needs Locations.Austria (CITY_NOT_FOUND otherwise, nothing
  written). Role MeterReporter.
- /meterReadings (…a63/…a64): many 15-min values per call, addressed by metering point number +
  direction, validated per value (grid, 0..1000 kWh, not in the future, within participation,
  not after the cut-off of the day = the allocation's cut-off) and upserted into the raw archive
  ec0000000000000000000a01 with DataQuality L1 and SourceDocumentDate = request time, so a later
  report replaces an earlier one until the cut-off. Partial acceptance answers status partial
  with the rejected indices. The write block is the allocation's. Role MeterReporter.
- /communityBalance (…a65/…a66): read-only provisional balance of the last N closed slots
  (default 4, max 96) with the allocation algorithm, optionally per metering point. Roles
  MeterReporter or EnergyCommunityReporting.
Every route answers HTTP 200 with the outcome in the body; a final Project@1 (clear +
inclusion) returns only the result fields, never headers, principal or the request body,
and no request body is logged. All data nodes run with identity ServiceAccount.
Seeds the role MeterReporter (ec0000000000000000000503, seed-data/identity/roles-groups.yaml);
a client-credentials client gets it with AddClientToRole. Tenant separation for
client-credentials tokens (a token of tenant A must not be accepted by the adapter of tenant B)
needs the adapter tenant check AB#5628; without it MeterReporter only proves the role, not the
tenant. REQUIRES Mesh Adapter release with RegisterSelfReportedMeteringPoint@1,
PrepareMeterReadings@1, CommunityEnergyBalance@1 (AB#5636/5637/5639) - an older adapter fails
the deploy of these three DataFlows with an unknown node type; the other DataFlows are not
affected. CK floors unchanged (EnergyCommunity 4.9 already carries MeteringDataSource
SelfReported and CommunitySettings.AllocationCutOffTime).
2.11.0 -> 2.11.1 (AB#5528): System.Communication ranges only - the upper bound moves from 4.0
to 5.0 in blueprint.yaml and every seed ([3.26,5.0)), the floors stay. Nothing in this blueprint
touches what System.Communication 4.0.0 renames (Pool -> DeploymentSite, Manages -> Hosts), so
the same seeds install on 3.x and 4.x. Without the widening a tenant migrated to 4.x refuses
every re-apply / update of this blueprint. No entity changed.
